# touchpoint-screen-flow-mockup.png

**Type:** UI screen-flow wireframe/mockup (numbered screens linked by
arrows), not a diagram of a formal notation.
**Source context:** `## Screen Flows` section, captioned "UC2 -
Touchpoint view - lambda operator", illustrating the customer-facing
capture flow for an internet connectivity product with add-ons.

Screen 0 "LoP1 LoP2 LoP3" — current offers for the service address,
with checkboxes for activities needing support (Gaming, TV Apps
streaming e.g. PrimeTV/AppleTV/Netflix, Remote working, ...) and a
"How many users at home" field — leads via "Select Line of Product -
Internet" to Screen 1 "Internet Connectivity", offering four commercial
contract tiers (Real-Time, Gold, Silver, Bronze), each a "Commercial
Offer" per the legend. From there, two parallel add-on screens: Screen
2 "TV Add-on?" (Basic TV channel — highlighted/selected in red, Extra TV
channel, or "I don't need TV") and Screen 3 "Other Add-on?" (Mobile
Backup — highlighted/selected in red, VPN** Service, or Home Security**).
Legend notes: LoP = Line of Product; service address has been
pre-tested for technology support (*); items marked ** are not
depicted further in this flow.
